module_summary: Dual-clock AXI-Stream FIFO wrapper: optional width adapters before/after (bypassed when widths match) around an async FIFO instance exposing pause and depth/frame status.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input stream payload routed through pre-FIFO path into async FIFO.

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input stream valid forwarded to FIFO write side.

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input backpressure from FIFO write side.

anchors.name: s_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Frame end marker stored with data for frame handling.

anchors.name: s_axis_tkeep
anchors.why: Input byte-lane keep forwarded to FIFO.

anchors.name: s_axis_tuser
anchors.why: Input sideband user bits, used for bad-frame marking.

anchors.name: s_axis_tid
anchors.why: Input stream ID sideband, disabled by ID_ENABLE=0 default.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdest
anchors.why: Input stream dest sideband, disabled by DEST_ENABLE=0 default.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output stream payload from async FIFO read side.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output stream valid from FIFO read side.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream backpressure feeding FIFO read enable.

anchors.name: m_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Output frame end marker from FIFO.

anchors.name: m_axis_tkeep
anchors.why: Output byte-lane keep from FIFO.

anchors.name: m_axis_tuser
anchors.why: Output sideband user bits from FIFO.

anchors.name: s_status_depth
anchors.why: Write-domain FIFO occupancy reported by the async FIFO.

anchors.name: m_status_depth
anchors.why: Read-domain FIFO occupancy reported by the async FIFO.

anchors.name: s_status_overflow
anchors.why: Write-side overflow indication from FIFO frame logic.

anchors.name: s_status_bad_frame
anchors.why: Write-side bad frame indication from FIFO.

anchors.name: s_status_good_frame
anchors.why: Write-side good frame indication from FIFO.

anchors.name: s_pause_req
anchors.why: Pause request to FIFO write side, disabled by PAUSE_ENABLE=0 default.

anchors.name: m_pause_req
anchors.why: Pause request to FIFO read side, disabled by PAUSE_ENABLE=0 default.

groups.description: Slave AXI-Stream input, optionally upsized, feeding the FIFO write side.

groups.name: Async FIFO
groups.description: Dual-clock FIFO instance buffering stream words, with pause control and status outputs.
